available_compute.formal_policy: one llama-server/model slot at a time; sequential Qwen then Granite

BIRD_Mini_Dev.role: development-visible public cross-database comparator; not sealed

methods: B0_DIRECT: full schema and evidence, one call
B1_DECOMP: schema links plus clause plan, one call
B2_SCHEMA_SELECT: deterministic BM25 schema selection, one call
B3_EXEC_REPAIR: initial plus mandatory feedback-bound second call
bird_freeze.human_gate: A real human must create an approval JSON binding the exact freeze SHA and acknowledging 5000 calls.
bird_freeze.claim_boundary: Independent transparent public baselines; not DKASQL reproduction and not sealed validation.

external_current_state.review_packet: READY for two independent real reviewers plus third-person adjudication
external_current_state.important_boundary: The existing 91 are development-visible and cannot be made sealed retroactively.

priority_matrix.statistics: Per-database rates and failures; predeclared B2-vs-B0, B3-vs-B0, B3-vs-B2 paired contrasts within each backbone plus cross-backbone modifiers; exact database-cluster sign enumeration over 2^11=2048 assignments; database-cluster composition-sensitivity bootstrap; Holm family of nine.
deliverables: 5000 immutable call rows and 4000 final prediction/score rows
model/prompt/data/runtime hash manifests and incident ledger
independent re-execution audit of all 4000 final predictions
per-database CSV/TeX tables, paired-effect plot, error taxonomy
bounded manuscript comparison that explicitly excludes DKASQL reproduction
human_dependencies: explicit launch approval bound to freeze SHA 29C780...B42AF5
author decision to spend the 5000-call compute budget

priority_matrix.experiment: Qualified review and unsealed external evaluation on the existing 91 RTS-GMLC/SimBench candidates
priority_matrix.estimated_human_hours: 35-55 total: two complete reviews plus adjudication/re-review
priority_matrix.statistics: Field coverage, raw agreement, Cohen kappa and Gwet AC1; 17-family-cluster paired randomization and bootstrap; dataset-stratified exact denominators; no use of the two datasets themselves as inferential clusters.
deliverables: two locked completed review forms
agreement report and conflict ledger
third-person adjudication and re-executed revised SQL hashes
new two-backbone 91x4 run; prior Qwen diagnostic retained only as development history
dataset/family error table and external-effect forest plot
priority_matrix.claim_boundary: Human-reviewed but unsealed; cannot by itself establish untouched test performance.

priority_matrix.experiment: New genuinely sealed RTS-GMLC/SimBench confirmatory set
priority_matrix.allocation: 30 RTS-GMLC and 30 SimBench; at least 12 family/SQL-structure strata
priority_matrix.estimated_human_hours: 40-70 for independent authoring/deep rewriting, dual review, leakage audit and adjudication
priority_matrix.statistics: All-attempt execution accuracy/agreement with Wilson descriptive intervals; paired family-cluster exact randomization where cluster count permits; family-stratified bootstrap; dataset-specific denominators; no post-unsealing exclusions.
deliverables: access-controlled hidden question/gold package
authoring and qualification attestations
duplicate, normalized-SQL, template-family and semantic leakage audit against GridDB and the existing 91
pre-unsealing method/configuration freeze
single no-drop 480-call sealed batch and independent re-execution audit
sealed results table, failure appendix and audit trail
human_dependencies: independent real domain authors who are outside the model/prompt development loop
two qualified reviewers and a third adjudicator
custodian who controls access until the entire registered batch is complete
priority_matrix.nonnegotiable: The current 91 development-visible items must not be relabeled sealed.

priority_matrix.statistics: Freeze one nonzero sampling configuration before generation; all five seeds use identical prompts and full denominators. Report execution mean, range and within-question variance; SQL-string and denotation stability; hierarchical logistic model or GEE with question/structural-cluster dependence and seed effect; paired cluster bootstrap and Holm-adjusted planned contrasts.
deliverables: five-seed protocol freeze and deterministic call order
7200 prediction/score rows with no cherry-picking or dropped failures
seed-by-cell stability table and heatmap
question-level disagreement/error-transition ledger
independent aggregate recomputation
human_dependencies: author approval of the added stochastic protocol and compute scope
priority_matrix.warning: Changing seeds at temperature 0 is not a meaningful stochastic replication; a common nonzero sampling configuration must be frozen and all five runs regenerated.

priority_matrix.statistics: Predefined error taxonomy, database/family/difficulty strata, no pooling that hides failed calls, sensitivity excluding empty-reference cases only as labeled diagnostics, and concordance of effect directions across GridDB, BIRD and the two power-grid datasets.
deliverables: cross-dataset evidence-tier table
effect-direction matrix
failure and empty-result sensitivity appendix
claim-to-artifact ledger and updated review-response matrix
human_dependencies: domain interpretation and author approval of revised claims

full_program_budget.estimated_gpu_hours: 6-12 with one RTX 3090; reserve 14 hours including server transitions and validation
full_program_budget.estimated_human_hours: 75-125, dominated by external authoring/review/adjudication and declarations

recommended_sequence: Obtain BIRD launch decision and recruit external reviewers/authors in parallel.
Freeze the five-seed GridDB and new sealed-set protocols before any new generation.
Run BIRD sequentially Qwen then Granite, preserve incidents, then independently audit before analysis.
Complete review/adjudication of the existing 91 and separately create/leakage-audit the new hidden set.
Run the reviewed-unsealed and sealed external batches only after their respective gates pass.
Run the five-seed GridDB factorial under one frozen stochastic configuration.
Perform independent statistical recomputation and integrate only evidence whose gate is closed.
hard_prohibitions: Do not run BIRD without the exact human approval companion.
Do not describe BIRD as sealed or as DKASQL reproduction.
Do not relabel the current 91 external candidates as sealed.
Do not use agent review as qualified human domain review.
Do not use the existing Qwen external diagnostic as post-adjudication canonical evidence.
Do not vary one factor at a time after observing results or drop failed generations.
Do not run Qwen and Granite servers concurrently on the single formal GPU slot.
